requirements.quote: 8. The recommendations and opinions of each Proposer’s previous customers or clients.

requirements.quote: 9. Information provided in response to specific questions and requirements contained in the RFP and all attachments/exhibits.
requirements.text: Respond to all specific questions and requirements in the RFP and its attachments.

requirements.quote: The Proposer must certify in the proposal that its fee covers all services proposed and meets the requirements of this RFP.
requirements.text: Certify that the proposed fee covers all services and meets RFP requirements.

requirements.quote: Proposals failing to meet the requirements of this RFP may be eliminated from consideration.
requirements.text: Ensure the proposal meets all RFP requirements to avoid elimination.

requirements.quote: Qualified staff/individuals will evaluate all submitted proposals.
requirements.text: Understand that qualified staff will evaluate all proposals.

requirements.quote: The Authority may request clarification of a proposal.
requirements.text: Be prepared to provide clarifications on the proposal if requested.

requirements.quote: (i) withdraw or cancel the RFP at any time and at its sole discretion;
requirements.text: The Authority may withdraw or cancel the RFP at any time.

requirements.quote: (ii) reject any or all proposals received in response to this RFP;
requirements.text: The Authority may reject any or all proposals.

requirements.quote: (iii) accept a proposal and any subsequent proposal for the contract from someone other than the lowest cost Proposer consistent with the criteria for the evaluation of proposals;
requirements.text: The Authority may accept a proposal not necessarily from the lowest cost proposer.

requirements.quote: (iv) make an award under the RFP in whole or in part;
requirements.text: The Authority may make an award in whole or in part.

requirements.quote: (v) disqualify any proposer whose conduct and/or proposal fails to conform to the requirements of the RFP;
requirements.text: The Authority may disqualify proposers not conforming to RFP requirements.

requirements.quote: (vi) seek clarifications and revisions of proposals;
requirements.text: The Authority may seek clarifications and revisions of proposals.
